instruments.notes: Refinery fuel gas purchase hedge (Meraux, Louisiana refinery); Murphy pays fixed average $3.35 and receives average NYMEX price of final three trading days of month. Fair value recorded as an asset ($5.2 million in Item 7A; $5,225 thousand in Note K). Notional is remaining volume at 12/31/2005.
instruments.evidence_quote: In each month of settlement, the swaps require Murphy to pay an average natural gas price of $3.35 per MMBTU and to receive the average NYMEX price for the final three trading days of the month.
